item.title: Open Call: Mural Artists for Ypsilanti Utility Box Series 2026
item.description: The City of Ypsilanti seeks muralists for a utility box public art series. Stipend $800 per box. Deadline July 18, 2026. Community engagement statement and 3 portfolio images required. Apply at the link. Contact publicart@ypsilanti.example.

item.title: Vendor Applications Open — Ferndale Sacred Makers Market
item.description: Curated makers market in Ferndale seeking handcraft and jewelry vendors. 10x10 booths, $45 vendor fee. Application deadline June 30. Strong foot traffic, queer-friendly, immersive ritual vibe encouraged.

item.title: DJ Selectors Wanted — Detroit Ecstatic Dance Summer Series
item.description: Detroit Ecstatic Dance books guest DJs for ritual / tribal / downtempo journey sets. Conscious dance floor, sound journey format. $150 per set. Email booking@ecstatic.example to be considered. Ongoing through August.
